Senses.Explanation: The earth-half of the paired totality simile — heaven covering all, earth bearing all — deployed wherever the masters name what holds everything. Yuanwu Keqin, arriving at Deshan, runs the parallel prose — the ancient mirror, the ten thousand images on its stand, the sword cutting the group's devices — until it lands: heaven covering all, earth bearing all, every head and every thing plainly lit, the key ford cut off and the buddha-choosing hall opened; Dahui Zonggao, in a general discourse, cries that the Great Plum's plums are ripe, smashed to a hundred bits on Layman Pang's tongue-tip — heaven covering all, earth bearing all, not one thing not lit, not one thing not clear, that very place of clarity one root with heaven and earth, one body with the ten thousand things; Tian'an Sheng, at the mid-seventh water-land service, names the power all beings lean on — heaven covering, earth bearing, sun shining, wind blowing — some bearing it as buddha-ancestor bodies, some as heaven-born bodies, some as poor and lowly bodies; and Daxiu Zhu, after the Dadian head-seat case, flicks his whisk once: meet it here — heaven covering all, earth bearing all — and thread the head-seat's nostrils on one string. Baichi Xingyuan, for a laywoman's sixtieth year, asks after the thus-come one's one sentence — the canon multiplies empty words and buries the purport — then grants it: heaven covering, earth bearing, wind blowing, sun shining, through sound and through color, past silence and past language; Yinyuan Longqi, for the precept-candidates turning from the partial to the round, turns the halves inside out — earth bearing first, heaven covering after — then opens the cloth sack at the crossroads to fish beings out and repay the bodhisattva's debt; Baiyu Jingsi sets it under the one road the thousand sages do not transmit — heaven covering all, earth bearing all, every mote and every land nowhere unpervaded, so what talk of transmitting or not; and Yulin Tongxiu, at the installation, lifts the kasaya — heaven covering all, earth bearing all — the good wind bearing on every side, everything blown into this one.
